summary: Pre-market view: the composite risk score reads 61.38 and the level has escalated to high_risk, 2.07 above the previous published layer of 2026-10-14 at 59.31. The pressure sits in macro at 73.96, equity structure at 67.55, liquidity and credit at 63.15 and cross-asset at 87.5, while volatility at 18.82 and trend at 45.0 still do not confirm. Note that trend_1d in the fact layer is 0.0 because the 2026-10-15 row was already written at 61.38 by an earlier run on the same day, so the field is a same-day comparison and must not be read as an unchanged overnight. In the overnight US session of 2026-10-14 AI hardware led the decline: Nvidia closed at 221.300003 (down 3.1595 percent), Broadcom at 346.25 (down 3.0954 percent), Micron at 914.130005 (down 4.0978 percent), AMD at 570.820007 (down 5.7322 percent) and Tesla at 367.160004 (down 2.1507 percent). The Asia session of 2026-10-15 weakened in step, with A-shares at 43.59 for 688825.sh (down 5.2391 percent), 278.220001 for 603986.sh (down 4.9016 percent) and 244.0 for 301308.sz (down 6.143 percent), all three prices and single-session bases individually verified. Cross-asset confirmation has risen to 0.875 with 7 of 8 production signals triggered, contributing 13.125 points as the largest single driver. US PPI and advance retail sales land at 12:30Z today, alongside TSM results (actual 4.6 against a 4.45 forecast). Of the 22 sector and theme rows, 19 describe the US session of 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-14 and 3 have flipped to the Asia session of 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.875 with 7 of 8 production signals triggered, the only miss being high-yield OAS above 4; the 15 percent weight dimension contributes 13.125 points, the model's largest single driver, carried at a 0.8 proxy discount.

The equity structure dimension has risen to 67.55 with visibly deteriorating internals: the new-lows ratio at 0.2756 (43 of 156 qualifying) against a new-highs ratio of 0.0064 (only 1), the share above the 200-day average at 0.471 (73 of 155), small-cap relative weakness of 10.7087 percent and semiconductor relative weakness of 4.6035 percent.

Rates still dominate the macro picture: the 10-year real rate at 2.88 percent sits at the 99.36 percentile with a risk score of 99.36 and contributes 4.968 points, while the nominal 10-year at 5.21 percent sits at the 99.2 percentile with a risk score of 98.39 and contributes 4.9195 points. Together they support the macro dimension at 73.96.

Credit and liquidity: high-yield OAS at 3.16 percent (65.35 percentile) contributes 5.228 points and investment-grade OAS at 0.83 percent sits at the 47.32 percentile; the liquidity and credit dimension scores 63.15, within which reverse repo at 0.201 maps to a risk score of 97.75 under the neutral-direction rule.

The volatility dimension at 18.82 does not offset that pressure: VIX at 15.27 (25.4 percentile) and realized volatility at 10.328 both remain low. The marginal change in this risk reading is therefore still priced by rates, credit and cross-asset rather than confirmed by volatility.

supporting_signals.claim: The cross-asset set is a textbook risk-off basket: the S&P down 1.081 percent, bitcoin down 2.72394 percent at 81050.0, copper down 0.7336 percent and gold up 1.6651 percent, compounded by a dollar index of 121.6023 and real-rate pressure, giving 7 of 8 signals triggered in the same direction.

21 of the 22 sector and theme rows closed lower and only consumer electronics gained 0.6067 percent, with the worst rows at memory 10.2735 percent, AI infrastructure 7.263 percent, data centres 6.5829 percent, quantum computing 6.3591 percent and networking 6.1304 percent, followed by semiconductor equipment at 4.831 percent and semiconductors at 4.5008 percent.

US AI hardware is not a one-day pullback: over a week Nvidia is down 6.8093 percent, AMD 11.6186 percent, Broadcom 8.037 percent and Micron 15.9807 percent, which marks this as a trend rather than noise.

The trend dimension at 45.0 remains the only moderate reading among the six: price sits 6.267 percent above its 200-day average, 1.2181 percent below its 52-week high, with 3-month momentum of 2.5149.

The A-share semiconductor reading is a single-session number for 2026-10-15 with a 2026-10-14 base: 688825.sh down 5.2391 percent, 603986.sh down 4.9016 percent and 301308.sz down 6.143 percent; at the same time Jiangbolong guided first-three-quarter net profit up 1865-1991 percent (importance 69.85), with a 62.35-importance syndication of the same item, so fundamentals and price disagree.

contradicting_signals.claim: The memory theme prints a 10.2735 percent decline built from only 2 of its 8 constituents, the Korean lines over 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15; consumer electronics gains 0.6067 percent from 2 of 10 and robotics falls 1.693 percent from just 1 of 9. None of the three is a sector-wide reading.

19 of the 22 rows still describe the US session of 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-14 and only 3 describe the Asia session of 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15, so one pass over the table mixes two sessions and two bases, and the 10.2735 percent memory figure does not track the actual US memory move.

The risk level and the regime label pull against each other: the score of 61.38 is high_risk while the regime is still risk_on, resting on low volatility or strong momentum alone, with VIX at 15.27, realized volatility at 10.328 and 3-month momentum of 2.5149 supporting the label while the new-lows ratio of 0.2756 points the other way.

trend_1d printing 0.0 does not mean an unchanged overnight: the same-calendar-day 2026-10-15 row had already been written by an earlier run, so the field is the gap between two runs on one day, and the comparable read against the previous session is the 2026-10-14 row at 59.31.

The macro layer is split across vintages: PCE at 3.0076 is still dated 2026-08-01, headline CPI at 3.71725 with core at 2.56584 and unemployment at 4.2 percent are dated 2026-09-01, while rates and credit are 2026-10-13 and breakevens with reverse repo are 2026-10-14, so vintages must be aligned before comparing across dimensions.

Inflation and rates diverge: headline CPI moved from 3.35302 to 3.71725 and core from 2.44616 to 2.56584, yet the 10-year yield eased from 5.24 percent to 5.21 percent and the real rate from 2.91 percent to 2.88 percent, so the market is pricing hike risk and growth risk at the same time.

Model confidence is 0.8835, dragged down by a consistency factor of 0.5576 even though data quality is 1.0 and coverage is 0.93, which means the six dimensions disagree on direction and the reading is less interpretable than its coverage suggests.

The media figures inside the news window are not part of the fact layer: the Nikkei down 4 percent, Korean equities down more than 7 percent and SK Hynix down 10 percent all come from Chinese aggregators relayed second-hand through RSSHub, so they are directional colour rather than citable readings; the top item at 81.53 is a first-hand English report.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score moved from 59.31 to 61.38 and the risk level escalated from caution to high_risk.
The equity structure dimension rose from 66.6 to 67.55 as the new-lows ratio moved from 0.2564 to 0.2756.
Cross-asset confirmation rose from 0.75 to 0.875 and the cross-asset dimension from 75.0 to 87.5, making it the largest driver.

US AI hardware sold off together in the 2026-10-14 session: Nvidia down 3.1595 percent, AMD down 5.7322 percent, Micron down 4.0978 percent, Broadcom down 3.0954 percent and Tesla down 2.1507 percent.
The A-share leg is back on a single-session base, the 2026-10-15 close against 2026-10-14: 688825.sh down 5.2391 percent, 603986.sh down 4.9016 percent and 301308.sz down 6.143 percent.
The inflation readings stepped up: CPI from 3.35302 to 3.71725 and core CPI from 2.44616 to 2.56584, while PCE at 3.0076 did not update.
Credit and liquidity tightened at the margin: high-yield OAS from 3.11 percent to 3.16 percent and reverse repo from 0.275 to 0.201.
Three sector rows now carry Asia-session readings: memory at 10.2735 percent, consumer electronics at 0.6067 percent and robotics at 1.693 percent.
watch_next: US PPI and advance retail sales land at 12:30Z, the first hard test of inflation pass-through and demand resilience.
TSM has reported, with an actual 4.6 against a 4.45 forecast; its guidance will decide whether the AI hardware chain can stabilise.
The inflation print validates the market's pricing of volatility around 12:30Z, with the dollar index at 121.6023 and reverse repo at 0.201 as the key levels.
Watch whether VIX at 15.27 catches up: realized volatility at 10.328 is still low and the volatility dimension at 18.82 has not confirmed.
Breadth is the next confirmation point: if the new-lows ratio expands from 0.2756 while the new-highs ratio stays pinned at 0.0064, equity structure at 67.55 still has room to rise.
High-yield OAS at 3.16 percent is still short of the 4 trigger threshold, and a break would lift both the liquidity and the cross-asset dimensions at once.

The three Asia-session rows (memory 10.2735 percent, consumer electronics 0.6067 percent and robotics 1.693 percent) will revert to a US base in the next layer, so they should not be compared across layers.
Earnings density rises: 2026-10-20 brings GE, GM, NFLX and UAL, and 2026-10-21 brings META, T and TSLA, retesting the memory and AI narratives.

bull_case.title: Bull case: volatility stays low and breadth stabilises
points: VIX at 15.27 and realized volatility at 10.328 are both low, so if PPI and retail sales do not surprise to the upside the sentiment backdrop need not deteriorate further.
The trend has not broken: price is 6.267 percent above its 200-day average, 1.2181 percent below the 52-week high, and 3-month momentum at 2.5149 is still positive.
If the new-lows ratio falls back from 0.2756, equity structure at 67.55 and the composite at 61.38 can quickly retreat below 60.

base_case.title: Base case: consolidation inside the high_risk band
points: The score of 61.38 is already inside the high_risk band, with cross-asset at 87.5 and macro at 73.96 forming support, so a near-term retreat to the 59.31 line is unlikely.
Volatility at 18.82 and trend at 45.0 have not confirmed the pressure, so a full de-risking phase has not begun and there is no evidence of an index-level collapse.
Confidence at 0.8835 with consistency at 0.5576 signals internal disagreement, making sideways digestion at an elevated reading the most likely outcome.

bear_case.title: Bear case: volatility catches up and credit widens
points: If VIX rises quickly from 15.27, the volatility dimension at 18.82 turns into a leading contributor and the 61.38 composite has further room to rise.
If high-yield OAS at 3.16 percent breaks the 4 trigger threshold, cross-asset confirmation at 0.875 completes all 8 of its signals and liquidity and credit at 63.15 rises in step.
A continued expansion of the new-lows ratio from 0.2756 alongside the new-highs ratio at 0.0064 going to zero would confirm a breadth breakdown rather than mere high-level chop.
